Stále je to proxy kumulativní zátěže tká: It is still a proxy for cumulative tissue load, not a direct measurement of it; repeated smaller jumps in the same week are captured rather by creep and the fading memory. Internal load is missing without a heart-rate curve.
Subjektivní únava bývá časný signál — ro: Subjective fatigue is often an early signal — it rises before HRV or resting heart rate move. Only the last few days are taken (the daily check-in is a 'today' signal); persistent problems go through the weekly OSTRC.
Sám body nepřidává (od railway#91). Sniž: Adds no points by itself (since railway#91). It lowers load tolerance and multiplies the signal “Pain at the site of a previous injury”.
Tempo z GPS je zašuměné; nerozlišuje int: GPS pace is noisy; it doesn't distinguish intervals from a continuous acceleration.
Tep kolísá mezi dny až o 6,5 %, proto pr: Heart rate varies between days by up to 6.5 %, hence the average of several runs. Elevation is converted using the equation of Minetti et al. (2002), which describes an average runner.
Trend se srovná, jakmile se doplní síla: The trend levels out once calf and glute strength is added or the share of long runs is reduced.
Tyto projevy jsou typické pro únavové př: These signs are typical of bone stress from overload and should be assessed regardless of the pain number (Warden et al., 2014).

U dat ze sportovních hodinek předpovídal: In sports-watch data, acute exertion predicted injury more than distance itself (Neal 2024); load is best quantified with both an external and an internal component (Paquette 2020).

Vertikální oscilace sama o sobě je špatn: Vertical oscillation on its own is a poor unit — whoever lengthens their stride raises VO without losing economy. The normalised vertical ratio solves this. Lower vertical oscillation of the trunk is associated with better running economy and a lower vertical loading rate, which is a recognised risk factor for lower-limb injury. A rising VR in comparable conditions therefore suggests a loss of elastic push-off before it starts to hurt.
Vliv na toleranci zátěže klesá do 12 měs: The effect on load tolerance declines within 12 months of the injury.
Vnitřní zátěž napříč sporty — zachytí i: Internal load across sports — it also captures long moderate sessions and cross-training that running kilometres can't see.
Vysoká svalová bolestivost po tréninku j: High muscle soreness after training as a supplementary signal of incomplete recovery.
Vyšší HRV není automaticky dobrá zpráva,: Higher HRV isn't automatically good news; with functional overreaching it can also rise (Plews et al., 2014).
Vyšší vertikální oscilace znamená víc po: Higher vertical oscillation means more movement up/down instead of forward — less economical running and higher impact load per step. An increase vs your own norm at the same pace suggests worsening technique or fatigue.
Zachytí běžce, který nikdy nemá skutečně: It catches a runner who never has a genuinely easy day. High monotony at sufficient volume is a different failure mode from a volume jump — metrics based on volume alone can't see it.
Zařazení jednoho úplného volna a jednoho: Include one full rest day and one markedly shorter run each week.
Zmizí 14 dní po posledním označení dříve: Disappears 14 days after the last mark of a previously injured spot.
Zmizí, jakmile nejnáročnější běh posledn: Disappears once the hardest run of the last 7 days drops to your usual maximum (in both distance and intensity).
Zmizí, když se HRV/tep/spánek vrátí k ba: Disappears when HRV/heart rate/sleep return to baseline or the jump fades.
Zmizí, když se nejrychlejší běh vrátí k: Disappears when the fastest run returns to your usual pace.
Zmizí, když ustanou hlášené obtíže napří: Disappears when reported problems stop across the 28-day window.
Změna močení nebo stolice a necitlivost: A change in urination or bowel movements and numbness in the groin area are among the symptoms that require immediate medical examination. Fever or injury together with back pain are a reason for an early examination (international IFOMPT framework, Finucane et al., 2020).
Zranění = kumulativní zátěž překročí kap: Injury = cumulative load exceeds tissue capacity, and capacity is lowered by recovery (Bertelsen 2017). The same jump on a tired body exceeds the current capacity sooner than on a rested one — so the interaction is scored, not just the two quantities separately.
Ztuhlost před během klesne pod 4/5, nebo: Stiffness before runs falls below 4/5, or the share of training despite stiffness returns below 50 %.
Zvýšení klidového tepu proti vlastní nor: A rise in resting heart rate vs your own norm usually precedes a drop in performance and accompanies unresolved fatigue or an emerging infection.
Zátěž vyskočila, ale technika zatím drží: Load has jumped, but technique is holding for now. A deload is usually enough.
Závisí na kvalitě záznamu dřívějších zra: Depends on the quality of records of previous injuries and on reliable localisation (the knee is merged).
Depends on heart rate and the estimate of heart-rate limits.
Závisí na tom, jestli běžec hodnocení sk: Depends on whether the runner actually fills in the ratings. Low adherence silences the signal.

v0.4. Banisterův impulz-odezva model z v: v0.4. Banister's impulse-response model from the performance literature, carried over here as a complementary view of the EWMA ratio — it works better at low chronic load, where the ACWR ratio behaves unstably. A markedly negative balance means that acute load is persistently outpacing the capacity built.
v0.4. Doplňuje signál potlačené HRV o ji: v0.4. Complements the suppressed HRV signal with another axis: not how much HRV fell, but how unstable it is from day to day. Rising day-to-day variability without a drop in the mean is often an early marker of autonomic instability that the z-score of the mean alone would miss.
v0.4. Doplňuje spánkový dluh o jinou osu: v0.4. Complements sleep debt with another axis: not how much sleep is missing vs the average, but how irregular its duration is from day to day. Irregular sleep is associated with poorer load tolerance, also outside the running literature.
v0.5. Ztuhlost nohou před během je subje: v0.5. Leg stiffness before runs is a subjective signal of incomplete recovery, collected retrospectively when rating a run. On its own it is just another symptom — more interesting is the pattern where the runner trains at a high perceived effort despite reported stiffness: that suggests a reduced ability to listen to one's own body, not just fatigue itself.

A-skip, B-skip and butt kicks led to less ankle flexion than running, while bounding led to greater ankle power (Abran et al., 2024). A-skip loaded the calf less than running, bounding markedly more (Trowell et al., 2021). That drills alone would improve endurance running economy has not yet been shown.

Osm týdnů cvičení středu těla třikrát tý: Eight weeks of core training three times a week improved plank endurance, balance and running economy in collegiate athletes (Hung et al., 2019). In recreational runners, adding core exercises combined with inspiratory muscle training to interval training improved economy and one-hour run performance (Tong et al., 2016). A review of studies, however, shows a large effect mainly on trunk endurance and balance, and only a small one on sports performance itself (Dong et al., 2023).
